caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cannon mounted on a rectangular wooden box. The cannon is cylindrical and colored in shades of brown and tan, with a hollow opening at the far end and a rounded section at the base. The cannon is supported by two wooden brackets attached to the top of the box, which has a flat surface near the cannon and is separated into two sections by a wooden divider inside. The box is light to medium brown in color and appears smooth, with visible lines representing the wood grain and several small dark dots resembling nails or screws along the panels. There is a circular hole on the visible side panel of the box. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or light beige color.
title: Cannon-shaped Ballot Box
